# agy-skills — Spec-Driven Development Toolkit for Google Antigravity

🇺🇸 English  |  🇧🇷 Português (Brasil)

A **stack-agnostic, battle-tested suite of 8 skills, operational rules, and starter templates** for **Google Antigravity** (CLI, App, and IDE). Turn any repository — Web, Backend, Mobile, CLI, or Monorepo — into a deterministic **Spec-Driven Development** workspace with GitHub Flow governance, interactive anti-skip guardrails, automated issue lifecycle management, and built-in security audits. > 📖 **Full Operational Guide:** Read [PLAYBOOK.md](./PLAYBOOK.md) ([🇧🇷 PLAYBOOK.pt-BR.md](./PLAYBOOK.pt-BR.md)) for step-by-step Git Flow walkthroughs, Mermaid diagrams, and FAQ. --- ## The 8 Operational Skills | Command | Role | What It Does | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | **`/ignite`** | Onboarding | Idempotently validates runtimes, dependencies, `.env`, `.gitignore`, GitHub CLI (`gh`), and `.session.json`. | | **`/scaffold /`** | Planning | Creates a canonical spec in `specs/.SPEC.md`, registers it in `docs/REGISTRY.json`, cuts an ephemeral branch off `origin/dev`, and sets `.session.json`. | | **`/focus [module]`** | Context | Sets or inspects `activeModule` in local `.session.json` (gitignored) to isolate work across solo or multi-dev sessions. | | **`/craft [context]`** | Engineering | Senior-engineer implementation loop guided by `SPEC.md`, Clean Code (SRP), design-system compliance, tests, and builds. | | **`/shield`** | Security | Active/passive audit covering the **4 Core Laws**: Secrets Hygiene, Anti-XSS/Injection & CSP, AuthN/AuthZ, and Privacy (LGPD/GDPR). | | **`/checkpoint`** | Packaging | Rebases on `origin/dev`, scans for secrets, generates `specs/checkpoints/YYYYMMDD_.PLAN.md`, posts a GitHub Issue journal, creates atomic Conventional Commits, and pushes. | | **`/dispatch [dev \| main \| sync]`** | Delivery | Opens PRs to `dev` (features/fixes) or `main` (releases), updates `README.md` & `CHANGELOG.md`, and on `/dispatch sync` pulls `dev`, closes zombie GitHub issues, updates PR statuses, and resets `.session.json`. | | **`/matrix [sync \| schema]`** | Architecture | Queries and reconciles the project's canonical catalog (`docs/REGISTRY.json`) against actual source files and specs. | --- ## Canonical Governance Pipeline ```mermaid flowchart LR A["/ignite\n(Env Setup)"] -.-> B["/scaffold\n(SPEC + Branch)"] B --> C["/craft\n(Code + Tests)"] C --> D["/shield\n(Security Audit)"] D --> E["/checkpoint\n(Rebase + Issue + Commits)"] E --> F["/dispatch\n(PR to dev + Docs)"] F --> G["Merge on GitHub"] G --> H["/dispatch sync\n(Pull + Close Issues + Reset)"] ``` ### Key Guardrails Built In - **Plan-Validate-Execute:** `/scaffold`, `/checkpoint`, and `/dispatch` always present an explicit plan and wait for confirmation (`ask_question`) before mutating Git history or GitHub state. - **Anti-Skip Protection:** Running `/craft` without an active module, `/checkpoint` without `/shield` on security-sensitive changes, or `/dispatch` with uncommitted changes pauses and recommends the prerequisite step. - **Zero Zombie Issues:** GitHub does not auto-close `Closes #N` issues when PRs merge into `dev` — `/dispatch sync` automatically closes every resolved issue via `gh issue close`. - **Safe Cross-Platform Shell Encoding:** All GitHub Issue and PR Markdown bodies are written to UTF-8 (no BOM) temporary files and passed with `--body-file` to avoid PowerShell backtick corruption. --- ## Installation Choose the setup that best fits your workflow: ### Option 1 — Install Globally as a Native Antigravity Plugin (Recommended) Works automatically across **all** your projects with zero duplication via the official `agy plugin install` CLI: **English (auto-adapts responses to your conversation or `AGENTS.md` language):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Leosdc/agy-skills.git agy plugin install ./agy-skills ``` **Português do Brasil (plugin nativo 100% em PT-BR):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Leosdc/agy-skills.git agy plugin install ./agy-skills/locales/pt-BR ``` *(You can verify any plugin locally anytime with `agy plugin validate ./agy-skills --strict` and inspect active plugins with `agy plugin list`.)* ### Option 2 — Install Inside a Specific Repository (`.agents/`) Ideal for sharing identical rules and skills with your entire team via Git: ```bash # English version mkdir -p .agents cp -r /path/to/agy-skills/skills .agents/ cp -r /path/to/agy-skills/rules .agents/ # Or Português do Brasil version mkdir -p .agents cp -r /path/to/agy-skills/locales/pt-BR/skills .agents/ cp -r /path/to/agy-skills/locales/pt-BR/rules .agents/ ``` ### Option 3 — Bootstrap Any Project with Starter Templates Copy the starter templates into your repository root and customize placeholders: | Template | Destination in Your Repo | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `templates/AGENTS.template.md` | `AGENTS.md` | Project stack, team leads, branch defaults, build/test commands | | `templates/REGISTRY.template.json` | `docs/REGISTRY.json` | Machine-readable catalog for `/matrix` and `/scaffold` | | `templates/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | Standardized PR checklist for `/dispatch` | | `templates/CHANGELOG.template.md` | `CHANGELOG.md` | Keep a Changelog file with `## [Unreleased / Dev]` | | `templates/session.example.json` | `.session.json` *(gitignored)* | Local developer context file for `/focus` | *(PT-BR equivalents are available under `locales/pt-BR/templates/`.)* --- ## Repository Structure ```text agy-skills/ ├── plugin.json # Native Antigravity plugin manifest (EN, language-adaptive) ├── README.md # Documentation (English) ├── README.pt-BR.md # Documentação (Português do Brasil) ├── PLAYBOOK.md # Operational Git Flow Playbook (English) ├── PLAYBOOK.pt-BR.md # Playbook Operacional Git Flow (Português do Brasil) ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── rules/ # Consolidated & modular engineering rules (EN) │ ├── AGENTS.md │ ├── architecture.md │ ├── git-governance.md │ └── security.md ├── skills/ # The 8 Antigravity skills (EN) │ ├── ignite/SKILL.md │ ├── scaffold/SKILL.md │ ├── focus/SKILL.md │ ├── craft/SKILL.md │ ├── shield/SKILL.md │ ├── checkpoint/SKILL.md │ ├── dispatch/SKILL.md │ └── matrix/SKILL.md ├── templates/ # Project starter templates (EN) └── locales/ └── pt-BR/ # Complete 1:1 native plugin & drop-in pack in PT-BR ├── plugin.json ├── rules/ ├── skills/ └── templates/ ``` --- ## Contributing & License Contributions, improvements, and additional locale packs are welcome via Pull Request! Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
